The phrase's single written *the* stands before *labor*, but the rectum הָאָדָם carries the article and is rendered anarthrously, which is rule 29's fronting case; כֹּל keeps a bare *All* because the ASV writes no *of* after it, and the construct עֲמַל takes only its own word.
The clause writes both a waw and גַם against the ASV's *and yet*, so each English connective answers to a morpheme of its own and nothing is in surplus.
The prepositional phrase is the predicate of the verbless clause, so the construction-supplied copula joins the לְ and the unit heads on it (rule 49).
